description: The value of a first-order term in an ultraproduct, with representative functions assigned to its variables, is the class of its coordinatewise values. Available bound placeholders may be included among those variables.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Ultraproduct.term_realize_cast.{u, v, u_1, u_2, u_3} {α : Type u_1} {M : α → Type u_2}
  {u : Ultrafilter α} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [(a : α) → L.Structure (M a)] {β : Type u_3} (x : β → (a : α) → M a)
  (t : L.Term β) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize (fun i => Quotient.mk' (x i)) t =
    Quotient.mk' fun a => FirstOrder.Language.Term.realize (fun i => x i a) t
